}}'''Simion''' is master [[Harod]]'s attendant at an inn called [[Harilin's Leap]], in [[Jarra (village)|Jarra]].

==Appearance==
Simion has a wide mouth and almost no chin.

==Activities==
When [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]], [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Loial]] travel through Jarra, Simion greets them and welcomes them to the inn. Simion sees Perrin's eyes, he asks Perrin to speak with Moiraine regarding his brother, [[Noam]]. Perrin and Moiriane go to see Noam and discover that, while he is a [[wolfbrother]], his humanity is lost and there is nothing either of them could do.{{ref/book|3|8}} Simion, in gratitude, brings Perrin's meals to his room so no more locals will see his eyes.{{ref/book|3|9}}

==Parallels==
According one legend, Bajan, the son of the Bulgarian ruler [[wikipedia:Simeon I of Bulgaria|Simeon the Great]] had the ability to transform himself into a wolf. It seems more than coincidence that he shares his name with someone who has a brother who had also transformed into a wolf.
